notes.text: The token endpoint is idempotent for the same refresh token, so a failed refresh can simply be re-sent with the same body. We settled on 3 attempts with exponential backoff.
notes.author: codex

notes.text: To retry a Keyline refresh safely, send the standard Idempotency-Key header, the same way billing does for Paylane.
notes.author: claude-code
